header: Cohort: ed. Chief complaint: right lower quadrant abdominal pain.

bundle.text: 23-year-old with 12 hours of periumbilical pain that migrated to the right lower quadrant.
Patient reports nausea, low-grade fever (38.2 C), and tenderness at McBurney's point.

header: Cohort: ed. Chief complaint: productive cough and dyspnea.

bundle.text: 68-year-old with 4 days of productive cough, rust-colored sputum, fever, and pleuritic chest pain.
Bibasilar crackles on auscultation; oxygen saturation 92 percent on room air.
Right lower lobe consolidation consistent with pneumonia.

header: Cohort: ed. Chief complaint: nausea, vomiting, polyuria.

bundle.text: 44-year-old with known type 2 diabetes mellitus, off insulin for one week, presenting with vomiting and Kussmaul respirations.
Reports polyuria, polydipsia, and 8-pound weight loss over the past two weeks.

header: Cohort: cardiac_mm. Chief complaint: progressive dyspnea on exertion.

bundle.text: 71-year-old with hypertension and prior MI; now with 3-pillow orthopnea and lower-extremity edema.
Dyspnea on minimal exertion; weight up 6 lb over one week.
Cardiomegaly with vascular congestion and bilateral interstitial edema.

header: Cohort: icu_mm. Chief complaint: oliguria, hypotension on admission to MICU.

bundle.text: 59-year-old with sepsis from urinary source, admitted to the MICU with shock requiring norepinephrine.
Urine output 5 mL/hr over the last 3 hours; serum creatinine doubled from baseline.
No acute cardiopulmonary process; endotracheal tube in good position.
